cues.en: And then you have some sort of output.
cues.zh: 最後產生某種輸出。

cues.en: Now a neural network, you might be wondering what are all these little nodes here?
cues.zh: 你可能會問，神經網路裡這些小點是什麼？

cues.en: They're also called nodes.
cues.zh: 它們稱為節點。

cues.en: Well, these are small models within themselves.
cues.zh: 可以把每個想成小模型。

cues.en: So what's going to happen here is that each of these small models is going to add up and figure out some kind of pattern in this data and then learn what that pattern relates to a.k.a the label.
cues.zh: 這些小模型一起運作，從資料找出某種模式，再學習該模式與哪個標籤相關。

cues.en: And so.
cues.zh: 所以。

cues.en: Where does deep learning come from if it's just if a neural network is just another type of machine learning model?
cues.zh: 如果神經網路只是另一種機器學習模型，深度學習的「深」從何而來？

cues.en: Well, this is where the deep part comes from.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: When building a neural network, you might use multiple layers.
cues.zh: 建立神經網路時，可以使用多層。

cues.en: So see here we've got our original one, but then you might add more neural networks on top of your original neural network.
cues.zh: 這裡是原本的網路，也可以在原有神經網路上加入更多層。

cues.en: And what this might do, what this and I say might, because again, it's a lot of trial and error in this sort of model finding.
cues.zh: 這可能帶來什麼效果？我說「可能」，因為尋找這類模型，同樣需要大量嘗試與出錯。

cues.en: That's why I said in the beginning the book on deep learning is yet to be fully completed yet because we're still working out the best way to lay out these neural networks.
cues.zh: 這也是一開始說深度學習還沒有完整定論的原因，因為仍在研究如何安排神經網路最好。

cues.en: And so I've got here a few more boxes than what we had in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 這張圖比上一張多了幾個方框。

cues.en: And what this means is that as you add more layers here, these other nodes, these smaller models in
cues.zh: 也就是增加層數後，這些節點、神經網路裡的，

cues.en: the neural network are going to start to be able to detect more and more features and thus hopefully
cues.zh: 小模型，可能開始偵測更多特徵，希望因此，

cues.en: getting better at identifying the information in our unstructured data.
cues.zh: 更擅長辨識非結構化資料中的資訊。

cues.en: Now, what kind of deep learning problems are there?
cues.zh: 有哪些深度學習問題？

cues.en: Well, we've spoken about classification.
cues.zh: 談過分類。

cues.en: We've also seen that in a heart disease project.
cues.zh: 心臟病專案也做過。

cues.en: But you might want to classify what kind of dog breeds are in an image or whether an email is spam or not.
cues.zh: 但也可能想分類影像裡的狗品種，或判斷電子郵件是不是垃圾郵件。

cues.en: In this case, this email is definitely not spam.
cues.zh: 這裡的郵件肯定不是垃圾郵件。

cues.en: Otherwise, there's a sequence to sequence problem also known as Sector SEQ.
cues.zh: 還有序列到序列問題，也叫 seq2seq。

cues.en: And now this is the kind of problem that happens with Siri or Google Home or something like that.
cues.zh: 像 Siri、Google Home 等系統，就會處理這類問題。

cues.en: It also happens with Google Translate.

cues.zh: 使用攝影機的自駕車，可能、也確實會遇到這種深度學習問題。

cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.zh: 需要辨識影像裡有哪些物件。

cues.zh: 講者以有八個攝影機的 Tesla 自駕車為例，持續找出路徑上的物件。

cues.en: And I mean, there's many more deep learning problems out there.

cues.en: And we mentioned transfer learning before.

cues.en: So what is transfer learning and why should we use it?
cues.zh: 什麼是遷移學習？為什麼要用？

cues.en: Well, the main premise of transfer learning is taking what, you know, in one domain and applying it to another.
cues.zh: 主要概念是，把某個領域學到的知識，應用到另一個領域。

cues.en: So if you're training a machine learning model to pick up different dog breeds and images and you're trying to train a machine learning model from scratch, that can be both expensive and time consuming.
cues.zh: 假如從零訓練模型，辨識影像裡的狗品種，可能昂貴又耗時。

cues.en: But if you've already got a machine learning model which is learned to identify other objects in images, the beautiful thing is you can use transfer learning.
cues.zh: 但如果已有模型學過辨識其他影像物件，就能使用遷移學習。

cues.en: So taking what that machine learning model or neural network taking those patterns at, it's learned in another set of images and then apply those patterns to your own problem.
cues.zh: 取出那個機器學習模型或神經網路，在另一組影像學到的模式，應用到自己的問題。

cues.en: So this leads us to question why not take advantage of what's already out there?
cues.zh: 所以會想，為什麼不善用現成的成果？

cues.en: Why not take advantage of what another model already knows?
cues.zh: 為什麼不利用另一個模型已經學到的知識？

cues.en: That's what we'll be looking at doing in this project.
cues.zh: 這就是專案裡要做的。

cues.en: And more specifically, what are we going to cover?
cues.zh: 更具體來說，會涵蓋什麼？

cues.en: Well, if you remember our psychic loan workflow.
cues.zh: 記得 scikit-learn 的流程。

cues.en: Our TensorFlow workflow is very similar.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 流程很相似。

cues.en: We've got to get data ready, but this time it's unstructured data rather than structured data.
